messages:
tara (People Ops): Quick check: Kevin is starting a 12-week unpaid sabbatical 2026-05-10 and asked if our annual 401(k) auto-escalation will still run. He also has HSA pre-tax elections. Who can confirm our vendor behavior and required steps to pause?

sam (Payroll): FYI payroll can't take contributions on unpaid earnings. Auto-escalation is a vendor/plan action. If vendor applies an election change effective a pay date with zero gross, nothing is deducted. But some vendors will still update the election percentage in the system for when pay resumes.

ivy (Benefits): Our plan allows participant-level suspension but vendor support varies. With our current vendor (Principal) we can do a one-off participant suspension via an admin form. For Fidelity it might be a participant e-sign. Need vendor confirmation.

kevin (IC): I prefer the escalation not to be scheduled while I'm away so it doesn't surprise me on return. Also curious about partial-pay weeks when I get a stipend.

sam (Payroll): If you receive any taxable stipend that goes through payroll and we apply deductions that pay period, the contribution will happen per the election active that pay. So if vendor updated the election while you were away, you could see the increased deferral on that stipend pay.

vendor-bot: Support ticket created: VND-2026-559 1 "participant suspension process". ETA 2 business days.

ivy (Benefits): Suggested steps: 1) Employee submits pause request to benefits@. 2) Benefits files vendor participant-suspend form (e-sign if available). 3) Payroll watches vendor feed for `escalation_suspended` flag before any stipend pay runs. 4) On return, employee requests resume or we resume automatically on return date if specified.

sam (Payroll): I'll add a payroll check to block applying new election percentages to stipend pay runs until we see the vendor flag. That requires a manual hold on the payroll line for the employee.

kevin (IC): Do I need to sign anything now? Can we do e-sign?

ivy (Benefits): Vendor confirmed VND-2026-559: e-sign accepted. They'll process within one business week and include the suspension flag in their next payroll export. I'll attach the e-sign link once it's live.

tara (People Ops): OK — action item list: Ivy to send e-sign link to Kevin; Sam to add payroll hold for stipend pay; Ivy to post a 1-paragraph FAQ in handbook. I'll draft the handbook text: "If you take unpaid leave, contact Benefits to pause auto-escalation; we'll use vendor-supported suspensions and coordinate with Payroll to prevent changes affecting any stipend pay."

kevin (IC): Thanks all, please send the e-sign link and I'll complete it today :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: VND-2026-559 updated: e-sign link provided to benefits team."
